item.title: NATO’s ‘Trump Whisperer’ Faces Blowback Over Support for Iran War
item.summary: Critics say Mark Rutte, the alliance’s secretary general, has gone beyond his remit by openly supporting a war that does not directly involve Europe’s collective defense.

item.title: Cheap Drones Remain Wild Card in Iran war
item.summary: Stopping Iran’s production of drones is critical to opening the Strait of Hormuz and halting its attacks on Gulf nations. But can it be done?

item.title: 2,000 U.S. Troops From 82nd Airborne Division to Be Sent to Middle East
item.summary: The order gives President Trump more military options as he considers diplomacy with Iran. It is unclear where the soldiers will go in the Middle East.

item.title: Here’s What Happened in the War in the Middle East on Tuesday
item.summary: The U.S. was said to have sent Iran a peace plan via Pakistan on a day that the Iranians fired a torrent of missiles across the region.

item.title: Senate Republicans Again Block Bid to Halt Iran War Without Authorization
item.summary: Senate Democrats failed for the third time to advance a resolution that would force the removal of troops from hostilities in Iran unless Congress approves offensive operations.

item.title: Iran Signals Resilience With Volley of Missiles Across Middle East
item.summary: The barrage continued as officials said the U.S. had sent Iran a 15-point plan to end the war. But Iranian officials have publicly denied that Washington and Tehran are talking directly.

item.title: Pakistan Offers to Host Talks Between Iran and the United States
item.summary: Pakistan, which has cultivated ties with both Washington and Tehran, sees a diplomatic opening to intervene in the war in Iran, its neighbor.

item.title: U.S. Said to Have Sent Iran a 15-Point Plan to End the Middle East War
item.summary: The 15-point plan was delivered via Pakistan, whose army chief has emerged as the key interlocutor between the United States and Iran, officials say.

item.title: High Oil and Gas Prices Could Outlast Trump’s War With Iran
item.summary: While the president has promised rapid relief, Americans could feel the financial sting of the conflict for some time after it ends.

item.title: Qatar Is Not Mediating U.S.-Iran Talks, Foreign Minister Says
item.summary: Qatar’s Foreign Ministry warned that the regional security system has been shattered, as the war has destroyed trust between Gulf countries and Iran.
